text:
Reading the photo as two cannelloni (baked pasta rolls) with meat sauce and cheese on a plate, plus a glass of cola or similar dark soft drink.

Cannelloni portion: two rolls, roughly 250 g, at about 160 kcal per 100 g, gives roughly 400 kcal.
Drink: about 200 ml of cola, roughly 85 kcal. It could be a zero-calorie drink, but I'm assuming regular cola.
Served: about 485 kcal.

I can't tell from a before-eating photo how much will be left, so I'm assuming a small amount of leftover, about 30 kcal.
Eaten: 485 − 30 = 455 kcal.

Macronutrient split for the cannelloni (about 370 kcal eaten): protein about 20 g, carbohydrate about 33 g, fat about 17 g.
Cola adds about 21 g carbohydrate.
Totals eaten: protein 20 g, carbohydrate 54 g, fat 17 g.
